main_text.l: זָבַד Donavit. זֶבֶד m. Donatio, Donum.
זֶבַח m. Sacrificium, Mactatio: plur. זְבָחִים.
זְבוּלָה f. Habitaculum, Habitatio. זְבוּל m.
זָבַן Chal. Emit, Redemit: Partic. זָבְנִין Redimentes; Dan.2.8. Pahel, זַבֵּן Vendere.
זֶה Hic, Ifte, Hoc, Iftud. בָּזֶה In hoc: Hîc: מִזֶּה Ex hoc, Ab hoc: Hinc Geminatum in eadem sententia; Hinc, Illinc. זֹאת Hæc, Ifta, Hoc, Iftud. [?]
זָהָב m. Aurum; Aureus numnus, metaphoricè Serenitas, Job 37.22. Aureus liquor.
זָהַם Fastidivit, Detestatus est tanquam sordidum & Inquinatum.
זָהַר Hiphil הִזְהִיר Splenduit, Fulsit: metaphoricè; Monuit; Admonuit. Niphal נִזְהַר.

page.notes: Hebrew entries are copied from a small, partly faded scan; vowel points and some forms (notably זִבְחָרָה, זֹאת and the Hiphil/Niphal forms) are doubtful and marked [?] where uncertain. The page number is read as 82 from the top right. The heading ז is the Hebrew letter Zayin.
